intros.after_preu: For a bachelor's degree, universities look at your qualification, CGPA, MUET, field or stream, and basic SPM results. Some programmes also check STPM, A-Level and matriculation subject grades (e.g. B in Biology).
intros.after_certificate: For a diploma, polytechnics and universities look at your certificate in a related field, its CGPA (or SKM level) and your basic SPM results.

higher.programmePlaceholder: e.g. Diploma in Computer Science / Certificate in Electrical Technology

subjectsHint.stpm: Enter every subject you took, including General Studies.
subjectsHint.a_level: Enter every A-Level subject you took.
subjectsHint.matriculation: Some degree programmes check particular grades, such as B in Biology. Subjects without a grade are not saved.
subjectsHint.foundation: Enter the grades of your main foundation subjects if a degree programme needs them, such as Biology or Chemistry.

sideBody.after_preu: Most public degree programmes ask for a CGPA of at least 2.00 (some 2.50–3.00 for diploma holders), MUET (usually Band 1–2), a credit in SPM Malay Language and a pass in SPM History. STPM also needs grade C in three subjects including General Studies; diploma, DVM and DKM holders are judged on a related field.
sideBody.after_certificate: Most diploma programmes ask for a certificate (MQF level 3, including SKM level 3) in a related field with a CGPA of at least 2.00, a credit in SPM Malay Language and a pass in SPM History. Some also ask for an SPM Mathematics credit or a bridging programme.

higher.sideNote: Actual requirements differ by programme and year. Always check with the university.
